run_pipeline_longcat_image: run the LongCatImagePipeline to generate images from text prompts with configurable resolution and guidance scale
create_pipeline_longcat_image: create a LongCatImagePipeline instance with scheduler, vae, text encoder, tokenizer, transformer, and text processor modules
run_encode_prompt: run the encode_prompt method to convert text prompts into embedded representations with position IDs for the transformer
run_rewire_prompt: run the rewire_prompt method to rewrite user prompts using a Qwen2.5-VL text encoder for improved image generation quality
run_prepare_latents: run the prepare_latents method to generate random latent tensors with packed image position IDs for diffusion
